free_tier.stated: a Free Trial, not a free tier: USD 5 of credits granted after a verified payment method is added, expiring 30 days after they are granted. The page answers 'Is there a permanently free tier?' with 'No.'
free_tier.notes: the trial's per-model limits are published: gpt-oss-120b and qwen-3.8-27b each at 5 RPM, 30K uncached TPM, 90K total TPM, 1M TPH and 1M TPD

retention.stated: the trial credits expire 30 days after they are granted

interface_detail: an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint at https://api.cerebras.ai/v1
tooling: any OpenAI-compatible client; curl against POST {base}/chat/completions
chaining: pairs with an agent only inside a 30-day trial and only after a card; the scarce link is the verified payment method, which turns a free offer into a payment relationship

limits.value: Free Trial, per organization and per model: gpt-oss-120b: 5 RPM, 30K uncached TPM, 90K total TPM, 1M TPH, 1M TPD. qwen-3.8-27b: 5 RPM, 30K uncached TPM, 90K total TPM, 1M TPH, 1M TPD, image limits 2 per request and 10 MiB total request payload. the USD 5 of trial credits expire 30 days after they are granted, and API access stops when they run out or expire

limits_note: the Developer (Pay as You Go) tier removes the hourly and daily token caps and raises the per-model rates: gpt-oss-120b 1M uncached TPM, 3M total TPM and 1K RPM; qwen-3.8-27b 150K uncached TPM, 750K total TPM and 300 RPM; that tier is pay-as-you-go and not free
binding_note: the 30-day credit expiry binds before any rate does: the whole allowance is USD 5 that disappears, so there is no recurring quota to design against

identity_cost.detail: a verified payment method is required before the USD 5 of trial credits is granted; without a payment method the Playground and API access remain inactive

reliability_note: an unauthenticated call returns 401 with 'Wrong API Key' and a 99-byte body, so an unauthenticated probe cannot distinguish a live endpoint from an expired one
